candidates.description: This feature vector represents French adverbial and quantifier words relating to degree, quantity, and extent.
This vector activates in response to biological, anatomical, and cellular terms.
This vector represents the concept of relative size, ratio, or proportion.
This vector represents linguistic roots and prefixes related to living environments, biology, and historical preservation across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents numeric values, specifically quantities or measurements often found in data or financial contexts.
This vector represents units of measurement and numerical quantities.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing or related to Latin-derived verb roots involving "duc" or "duce" (such as production, conduct, induce, and constituents).
This vector represents tokens containing the common letter sequence "ent".
This vector represents morphemes and root words related to the concepts of sea, evil, or music across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on adjectives and determiners indicating quantity, variety, or distinction.
